name: Air quality stations
summary: The national network of about 10 air-quality stations that measure particles, ozone and gases in Cyprus, run by the Department of Labour Inspection.

el.name: Σταθμοί ποιότητας αέρα
el.summary: Το εθνικό δίκτυο περίπου 10 σταθμών ποιότητας αέρα που μετρά σωματίδια, όζον και αέρια στην Κύπρο, από το Τμήμα Επιθεώρησης Εργασίας.

publisher.name: Department of Labour Inspection, through the World Air Quality Index project

quality.uncertainty: Reference-grade stations, but only a few on the island and Paphos has a traffic station only.
known_issues: Data shown by the republisher is unvalidated at the time of publication
Sources disagree on whether the network has 9, 10 or 11 stations

notes: Three routes, best first: the DLI dataset on data.gov.cy, the DLI website, or the World Air Quality Index API (needs a free token). The licence is not stated anywhere read so far: email the Department, say we are a school project and will credit it. Each of the four school cities has at least one station. Terms of a republished copy can be stricter than the original.
